recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: memory fabs bracing for a leaner horizon beyond 2026
ten-year chromebook promises beginning to shorten
san francisco wrapped in autumn fog before dawn
october's first sunset arriving earlier each evening

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Steer a one-thumb ferry through dense SF fog — collect faint lighthouse pulses before they dissolve into the gray.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each pulse found clears a pocket of fog, briefly revealing a ghost skyline silhouette.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Fog thickens, lanes narrow, and pulses appear in shorter windows.

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Sort memory chips into correct slots as supply pressure builds — a wrong placement triggers a stack-overflow cascade across the board.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Satisfying snap when a full batch clears before the pressure timer fills.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: New chip types appear, slots shrink, and the conveyor accelerates.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon PCB green on matte black

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Tap compile checkpoints across a branching rust crate graph — miss a node and the build-time balloon inflates upward.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Chain perfect taps to shave virtual milliseconds off a progress bar in real time.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Dependency branches sprout mid-sequence, demanding faster tap chains.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: terminal amber monospace with spark particles

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Hold to spawn parallel agent threads racing to patch the same code fragment — release at the exact merge moment before they conflict.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Aligned threads flash-merge into one clean diff with a burst of light.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: More agents spawn with overlapping edit paths and shorter merge windows.
